title: Replace with an implementation-neutral behavior title

included: State the behavior covered by this revision.
excluded: State adjacent behavior that is not specified.
non_goals: State what compatibility or implementation claims are not made.

platform_constraints: State architecture, ABI, operating environment, and observable dependency constraints.

terms.meaning: Define analyst-assigned language without implying an original type name.

interfaces.name: ReplaceWithObservedInterfaceName
interfaces.summary: Describe the observable contract, not its implementation.

requirements.title: One independently testable behavior
requirements.statement: The implementation MUST exhibit the stated externally observable result.
errors: State exact error behavior or say that none was observed in scope.
side_effects: State externally visible side effects or explicitly state none.
ordering: State required ordering or explicitly state that no ordering constraint is known.
requirements.test_oracle: Describe a black-box assertion without referencing original instructions.

evidence_claims.limitations: State what the method did not establish.

unknowns.impact: Explain how this limits implementation or compatibility claims.
